description: 按指定能力、任务或267模板目录中的多个模板生产协议绑定数据；pipeline_plan将能力或模板选择转换为selections。

inputs.preserve_source_splits: optional boolean, default false; explicitly true preserves each recorded source split without scene-group reassignment

outputs.questions: dataset/report with exact per-template and per-partition counts; SFT contains train items only
outputs.package: public/authority bundles; training bundle only for an entirely train dataset
